name: loopseed
description: Explicit, goal-driven, evidence-feedback loops for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Goal-driven loops with evidence and precise stopping.
interface.longDescription: An explicitly invoked Codex Skill that closes the highest-value verifiable gap, delegates only when useful, and stops with direct evidence or a precise blocker.
defaultPrompt: $loopseed Complete this goal, verify real progress, and continue until done or precisely blocked.
